As truck body builder, you will work in the bodywork department, helping to build brand-new trucks from start to finish. You may also carry out repairs for existing customers. In many cases, you and your team will have built the entire vehicle yourselves. Working from technical drawings, you will build complete trucks together with your colleagues. Seeing the reaction of a customer when they collect their finished truck is extremely rewarding!

You are focussed on details and strive for precision and perfection. Together, you aim to deliver every truck to the highest possible standard.

Don't worry if you don't have any experience yet. If you are motivated to learn and enjoy contributing to a beautiful finished product, we encourage you to apply immediately!

- You speak Dutch and/or English
- You are willing to attend training courses and develop your skills
- You are practical and enjoy working with your hands
- You have an interest in technology and technical work

SamenvattingDo you enjoy working with electronics and using your hands? Are you detail-oriented and like to see tangible results from your work? Join Logicall in Bleiswijk as a Production Worker, where you’ll refurbish returned devices and give them a second life.Over de functieAs a Production Worker, you play a key role in the refurbishment process of returned electronic equipment. You ensure that products are carefully restored and meet quality standards before they go back into circulation.
Your tasks include:
Disassembling modems, routers, and other electronic devices
Cleaning individual components and complete products
Testing parts and fully assembled devices
Reassembling products into proper working condition
Accurately recording test results and findings

You will work in a structured day shift from Monday to Friday, 07:30 to 16:30, providing a good work-life balance.
Over het bedrijfYou will join Logicall, an innovative company based in Bleiswijk that specializes in integrated logistics solutions within the technology sector. Sustainability is at the heart of their operations, with a strong focus on circular processes. By efficiently handling returns, they help extend the lifespan and value of electronic devices.
Wat wij vragenYou are comfortable standing for most of the day
You have experience as a production worker
You have an interest in electronics or technical work
You have a good command of the English language
You are accurate, detail-oriented, and a team player

Wat wij biedenGross hourly wage of €15.26
8.33% holiday allowance and 25 vacation days per year
Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometre
High chance of a permanent contract after 6 months
Opportunities for growth and development

In this role, you will be part of a close-knit and hardworking team. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all tasks are carried out as efficiently as possible so that the workday can be completed together.

As a Supply Chain Order Picker, you will work with your own picking trolley equipped with crates in which you collect customer orders. Once the crates are filled, you will place them on a conveyor belt, where they are automatically transported to the next department. You will use a handheld scanner in combination with a voice-picking system. During a comprehensive training session on your first working day, you will learn how to use this system.

Most of your work will take place in the warehouse, where you will collect products. Some of these products are stored in refrigerated or freezer areas. You will be provided with a warm jacket for working in these areas. After collecting the required products, you will return to the main warehouse.

The working days are Monday to Friday. (shift starts between 08:00 a.m. and 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 or 04:30 p.m.)

- Minimum of vmbo-level work and thinking skills
- One to two years of experience in a similar role
- Good command of the English language
- Willingness to work in a team and be flexible with shifts
- Experience with order picking and voice-picking systems is a plus

 - AS Watson - Warehouse Employee Kruidvat (start immediately) Wat ga je doen? 
Are you looking for a job to combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for an order picker and packer for the morning and afternoon shifts. You start your workday by receiving and checking incoming goods. Next you make sure that products are stored in the correct location in the warehouse. Using modern systems such as hand scanners and voice picking, you collect orders. You check if everything is correct and prepare the order for shipment. During your work, you are constantly on the move and actively contribute to a smooth logistics process! 
You work in a 2 shift system: - 07:00 - 16:00 (morning shift) - 16:00 - 00:00 (afternoon shift) 
These two shifts alternate weekly. Additionally, you work one Saturday every four weeks. Waar ga je werken? 
You will be working at A.S. Watson's modern distribution center. This is the warehouse responsible for supplying online orders for Kruidvat and Trekpleister in the Netherlands, Belgium and France. The work atmosphere is informal and energetic. Colleagues help each other and together you ensure the best results. The location is easily accessible from Arnhem, Amersfoort, Veenendaal and Wageningen among others. Coming by car? You can park for free right in front of the building! The warehouse is also easily accessible by public transport. You get opportunities to develop yourself through Olympia. For example with free Dutch or English language courses.
